articles.title: What Does Cisco Systems (CSCO) Fire Ant Router Espionage Mean For Investors?
articles.summary: Cisco Systems (NasdaqGS:CSCO) disclosed that a China linked group known as "Fire Ant" has been targeting Cisco IOS XR routers in a cyber espionage campaign. The threat actor has reportedly secured persistent access to high value network infrastructure, raising concerns over the security of affected routers and customer traffic.
